pipelines.name: document-agent
pipelines.description: Produce a finished business document from raw reference files end to end. Runs kb-builder to extract the team's format and product knowledge into a KB, then document-generator to write and render the final document (PDF or DOCX) directly from that KB.
triggers: generate a document from reference files
generate a document end to end
build KB and generate the document
produce a document from these references

pipelines.name: config-generator
pipelines.description: Generate a final configuration file (JSON, XML, YAML etc.) from reference documents. Runs kb-builder to extract knowledge, then config-agent to produce the config.

pipelines.name: kb-feedback
pipelines.description: Turn a user's complaint about a generated deliverable into approved amendments to the knowledge base that produced it, so the next generation is better. Point it at the kb-builder session whose KB is at fault via `seed_session_id`, and pass the flagged issues as `context`; optionally attach the defective deliverable and/or a corrected version as uploads (r2_keys/urls). Runs diagnose-bug in KB mode to analyse the KB against the feedback and propose amendments for review (adding a fact the KB never recorded, correcting one it recorded wrongly, or flagging a rule the KB already states correctly as a generator defect rather than restating it), then apply-fixes in KB mode to write the approved amendments back into that same KB in place. The KB is edited on disk with no git commit; the amended KB is written back into its own outputs/mcp bucket in place so every skill that reads it at runtime picks up the improvement.
triggers: the SOW you generated was wrong
the output was off-brand or incomplete
improve the KB from this feedback
the generated document missed something, fix the knowledge base
refine the KB from the flagged issues
reinforce the KB with this correction
update the KB from user feedback
